scenes.title: 一城山水
lines: 杭州，一面是西湖，一面是钱塘江。
Hangzhou: West Lake on one side, Qiantang River on the other.
这座城的年轮，就藏在湖与江之间。
The rings of the city lie between lake and river.

scenes.title: 杭州之名
lines: 公元五百八十九年，隋朝设置杭州。
The Sui established Hangzhou in 589.
城市，依着西湖东岸展开。
The city grew east of West Lake.

scenes.title: 运河通南北
lines: 隋唐，运河把杭州接入南北水路。
The canal connected Hangzhou to north and south.
粮食与丝绸往来，也带来更大的天地。
Grain and silk opened a wider world.

scenes.title: 吴越钱塘
lines: 五代，杭州成为吴越国都。
Hangzhou became the capital of Wuyue.
城郭、海塘与寺塔，留下新的印记。
Walls, sea dikes and temples left their marks.

scenes.title: 一堤留千年
lines: 一千零九十年，苏轼主持疏浚西湖。
In 1090, Su Shi directed the dredging of West Lake.
湖泥筑成长堤，后来，人们叫它苏堤。
Lake mud formed what became the Su Causeway.

scenes.title: 南宋临安
lines: 南宋定都临安，皇城在南，街市向北。
Southern Song Lin’an: palace south, markets north.
湖山之间，铺开繁华的城市长卷。
Urban life unfolded between lake and hills.

scenes.title: 把西湖迎进城
scenes.en: THE CITY OPENS TO THE LAKE
lines: 一九一三年，拆城开路。
In 1913, walls came down and roads opened.
西湖与街巷重新相遇，城市向外舒展。
The lake and streets met as the city expanded.

scenes.title: 向钱塘江生长
lines: 新世纪，杭州把目光投向钱塘江。
In the new century, Hangzhou turned to the Qiantang.
钱江新城，让城市重心从湖畔走向江岸。
Qianjiang New City moved the focus to the riverbank.

scenes.title: 一江连接两岸
lines: 桥梁跨过江面，两岸彼此连接。
Bridges linked the two banks.
钱江新城、滨江、钱江世纪城，交相呼应。
New urban centres grew together across the river.

scenes.title: 三处世界遗产
lines: 西湖、大运河、良渚古城遗址，先后成为世界遗产。
West Lake, the Grand Canal and Liangzhu became World Heritage.
三个时间坐标，照见杭州的深度。
Three landmarks reveal the depth of Hangzhou.

scenes.title: 古今在此交汇
lines: 今天，新的楼宇沿江而立。
Today, new towers rise along the river.
湖、河与江，仍是读懂杭州的线索。
Lake, canal and river still tell the city’s story.

scenes.title: 一城山水，千年生长
lines: 从西湖时代，到钱塘江时代。
From the West Lake era to the Qiantang River era.
年轮向外，山水在心。这，就是杭州。
The rings grow outward. The landscape stays at heart.
